newsitem.title: UK: Some 16 mln bbls of oil to be found in UK, Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Some 16 mln bbls of oil to be found in UK, Ireland.

text.p: Some 16 billion barrels of oil remain to be discovered beneath the offshore waters of Britain and Ireland, the Petroleum Services Group of Arthur Andersen said on Friday.
The estimated split of these reserves was 55 percent crude oil and 45 percent natural gas, the group said.
"The reserves represent approximately 25 percent of expected ultimate reserves and up to 70 percent of these 'yet to be discovered' reserves probably lie in frontier areas," the group said.

The group based its findings on the study of the reserve potential of six different geographical areas around Britain, reviewing expected drilling activity and assessing oil and gas find rates. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
